title: Course review and final project briefing
body:
You've now covered the full arc of this program:

  • Part 1 — Foundations: what generative AI and LLMs are, and how to write clear, effective prompts.
  • Part 2 — Core Techniques: advanced prompting strategies and applying AI across real-world tasks.
  • Part 3 — Going Deeper: system prompts, model behavior, APIs, no-code tools, RAG, and agents.
  • Part 4 — Mastery: evaluating and scaling prompts, multi-modal prompting, fine-tuning, and where the field is headed.

The Final Project asks you to bring all of it together: design, build, and document your own custom AI assistant for a real domain you care about. Head to the Final Project section next for the full brief.
